headline: Russell Brand was ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator, court told

members.title: Russell Brand trial for rape and sexual assault begins – live updates
members.lead: Russell Brand back in Southwark crown court today where his rape and sexual assault trial begins Continuing with the first alleged victim, Karmy-Jones said the woman met Brand at a fringe event at the Labour party conference where he was performing, and that they had engaged in a conversation that later continued in a hotel room. The complainant, who was in her 20s at the time, said when she came out of the bathroom at her hotel room, Brand was topless, the court heard. As she came out of the bathroom he was prancing around the room – a bit like an ostrich, doing silly walks like Basil Fawlty, she said. She was taken aback, she was shocked, she didn’t really know what to do – and in her words she froze. As you will hear, the defendant did achieve his objective. He found a victim, engaged with her, told her ‘exactly what she needed to hear’, and then manipulated the situation so as to have sex with her.” Once in the car, the defendant behaved oddly, shrinking down in the back seat to hide his head beneath the window. When pressed about where he had been the night before, and why they had to leave so abruptly, he said he had forgotten he had an audition.” Continue reading...

members.title: Russell Brand was ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator, court told
members.lead: Comedian faces three charges of rape, three of sexual assault and one of indecent assault against six women Russell Brand rape and sexual assault trial – latest updates Russell Brand was a ruthless, calculated and manipulative sexual predator who boasted about wanting to have sex with 5,000 women, a court has heard. The 51-year-old comedian is alleged to have had an “insatiable desire” to get what he wanted and treated women as a means to an end, jurors were told. Continue reading...
